Allegato: 1 immagine

I'm truly happy to share that next week I will take part in the conference of the European Sociological Association in Warsaw, Poland.

It will be a pleasure to present part of my thesis work on school student unions, to receive feedback and to learn from other scholars from each corner of Europe!
